children: Natasha Ovsepyan, through Takeover Time 2026 LLC, acquired a 62.45% stake in CHEETAH NET SUPPLY CHAIN SERVICE INC.'s Class A common stock. She disclosed the investment in a Schedule 13D filed on Sep. 21, 2026, after buying 1,846,000 shares on Sep. 17, 2026. The large position points to a push for direct influence over the company’s direction.

Ovsepyan plans to join the board. The filing states she "intends to seek a seat on the Board of Directors" and asks the company to "contact Ms. Ovsepyan to initiate direct discussions" about her board role.
She provided an email for direct outreach to move the process forward, signaling urgency and a desire to participate in governance soon.

Takeover Time 2026 LLC is a Delaware limited liability company focused on securities investment and related activities. Natasha Ovsepyan is its sole owner and managing member and directs all investment and voting decisions. She funded the purchase with personal funds contributed to the LLC.
